ABOUT US

About Ouyang Jude

湖北欧阳聚德汽车有限公司
Hubei Ouyang Jude Automobile Co., Ltd.

A Company Trusted by Customers, Proud for Employees

Hubei Ouyang Jude Automobile Co., Ltd., located in Zaoyang, Hubei Province, specializes in the R&D, manufacturing and sales of semi-trailers. Equipped with modern workshops and professional production lines, our products serve freight logistics and construction industries nationwide.

Using T700C ultra-high-strength steel with advanced welding technology, we achieve the perfect balance of lightweight design and high strength. Committed to quality-driven development, we continuously improve product quality and service through technological innovation.

ADVANTAGES

Core Strengths

01

Customers Come Back, and Bring Friends

In a market where switching cost is low, our customers come back to us and bring others. The cleanest signal that what we sell holds up after delivery.

02

From Spec Sheet to Driving Off

Daily peak output of 15 units, 8,000-unit annual capacity. Production scheduling is built around customer pickup, not the other way around.

03

Built for Your Cargo, Your Route

Different cargo, different roads. Six product lines with deep customization within each — no off-shelf compromise.

04

44 Patents · 10 Invention + 34 Utility

Practical innovations from the production line, granted by China's National IP Administration — 10 invention patents and 34 utility models, quietly cumulative since founding.
